notes.title: Major update to 'Where the Loong Lies': new features and content
notes.content:
Hello friends, this is the Jiaoren Culture Studio.
'Where the Loong Lies' has undergone a major version update in the early hours of today (May 21, Beijing time)!
The main content includes:
1. Fixed the bugs in the previous version and optimized the shortcomings in the previous version (such as the skip mechanism for inserting video playback).
2. Comprehensive optimization has been carried out in terms of space occupation, reducing the required space from 14GB to 2GB with a significant increase in game content.
3. The function of "Chronicle of Time" has been updated to display the date and allow for jumping.
4. The "Gallery" function has been updated, allowing you to browse CG.
5. Free updates to the original DLC storyline content - SP chapters and character profiles; The clearance and unlocking strategies can be obtained by joining the QQ group 'Where the Loong Lies'  official player group 801579861.
Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Preview of SP chapters, character profiles, and convenient features
notes.content:
[h1] [b] Preview of SP chapters, character profiles, and convenient features [/b] [/h1]
Hello, players and friends, this is the Jiaoren Culture Studio. Thank you for your purchase and support, thank you all!
The body of the work "Where the Loong Lies" was released on March 24th, and the DLC section is also in preparation. This preparation is not the "new folder" that everyone is familiar with, but it has entered the middle and late stages.
The first is the SP chapter. The SP chapter contains a total of three parts, mainly describing the past of Miss Wen, Wei Han's family, and Jiao Zhimin's family. Among them, SP · 1 will be presented to you in an interesting way, where you can choose to play a historical figure and briefly experience the history before the demise of South Vietnam; For SP · 2 · and SP · 3, we invited famous dubbing actors - Teacher Ziyin and Teacher Qiwen - to bring a more immersive experience to everyone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942721/d73b6a2fc9d15adf15cee9fdfc89b61b4da08f18.png[/img]
The second is the character file, which will use different expressions from the ontology, presenting the past and present lives of the main characters in the ontology in the form of various files. The form will include government documents, QQ records, and so on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42942721/98c0c4686762a1b1f38456f8b448fd61a114fc31.png[/img]
Finally, there are some convenient functions, such as the timeline (branch tree) and gallery, which will also be released with the version update on May 21st. The achievement system has been completed, but there are currently bugs (tragedies) that the great programmer teacher is urgently repairing.
In short, thank you all!
